_comment: Grandfathered orphans for lint-orphan-issues.mjs, ported from brikdesigns by
brik-bds#2792. Each entry is the number of an OPEN issue with no parent that the
2026-10-26 backfill knowingly left that way — no umbrella fit, or the issue is a
decision rather than work. The reason for each is on the #2792 backfill comment.
The gate is a ratchet: an orphan NOT listed here FAILS, and an entry that is no
longer an orphan (parented, closed, or relabelled meta:project) also FAILS until
you remove it — so the baseline can never overstate the debt.
Do not add an entry to make a red go green. Parent the issue, label it
meta:project if it is genuinely a Project, or put
`<!-- orphan-ok: <reason> -->` in its body per the discovery contract.
